name: bidi-mirror-type
title: Bidi Mirror Type
description: A dual-direction type specimen: the same phrase rendered LTR and RTL simultaneously, with per-glyph mirroring toggle and automatic dir attribute handling — a working tool for checking internationalised typography.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Toggle Mirror: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
